description: Find glossary entries by name, alias, or explanatory keywords when you do not know the ID. Supports multiword and bounded typo matching. Returns ranked summaries with score, matchedOn, and absolute url links; use get_term for full content.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return: default 10, maximum 50.

query.description: A name, alias, or useful keywords, for example "retrieval augmented" or the typo "kubernets".

name: search_terms
title: Search glossary
